sessions.title: Introduction to GitHub Copilot
sessions.description: What Copilot is, how the LLM works, plan tiers, privacy, and getting it running in the IDE for the first time.

sessions.title: Copilot Chat & Inline Suggestions
sessions.description: Mastering the chat interface, slash commands, inline completions, and Next Edit Suggestions across all IDE surfaces.

sessions.title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
sessions.description: How to construct prompts that reliably produce quality output — context, specificity, iteration, and custom instructions.

sessions.title: GitHub Copilot CLI & App
sessions.description: Using standalone Copilot CLI for terminal work, with Copilot App positioned alongside the VS Code hands-on baseline.

sessions.title: Agent Mode in the IDE
sessions.description: Autonomous multi-step tasks: Copilot reads files, runs commands, and iterates on errors inside VS Code.

sessions.title: Copilot Spaces & Context Management
sessions.description: Curated context sets, repository indexing, and managing what Copilot knows to improve output quality at scale.

sessions.title: Copilot for Code Review & PRs
sessions.description: AI-powered pull request reviews, automated summaries, issue-to-PR workflows, and Copilot Autofix in action.

sessions.title: Copilot App, Plugins & Canvas Extensions
sessions.description: Use Copilot App customization and build a shared canvas with bounded state, actions, and review evidence.

sessions.title: Copilot Cloud Agent
sessions.description: Assign issues to Copilot's cloud agent — it creates a branch, writes the code, runs tests, and opens a PR autonomously.

sessions.title: MCP Servers & Custom Tool Integration
sessions.description: Model Context Protocol: giving Copilot access to external tools, APIs, and data sources through standardized server interfaces.

sessions.title: Custom Agents & Agent Profiles
sessions.description: Building purpose-built agents with custom instructions, tool restrictions, and persona definitions for specific team workflows.

sessions.title: Agent Skills & the Copilot Ecosystem
sessions.description: Packaging reusable domain knowledge as agent skills, discovering community skills, and orchestrating multi-agent workflows.

sessions.title: GitHub Actions & Workflow Generation
sessions.description: Generating, debugging, and optimizing GitHub Actions workflows with Copilot assistance — from YAML to production CI/CD.

sessions.title: Infrastructure as Code with Copilot
sessions.description: Using Copilot to author, explain, and refactor Terraform, Bicep, and ARM templates with AI-assisted validation.

sessions.title: CI/CD Pipeline Debugging & Agentic Remediation
sessions.description: Diagnosing flaky pipelines and applying approved agentic remediation workflows for security findings.

sessions.title: Multi-Agent Team Orchestration
sessions.description: Optional patterns for coordinating specialized AI agents through planning, delegation, review, and iteration loops.

sessions.title: Enterprise Governance, Policies & Analytics
sessions.description: Content exclusions, policy configuration, seat management, usage analytics, and measuring AI adoption ROI at scale.

sessions.title: Spec Kit: Enterprise Specification-Driven Development
sessions.description: A governed specification-to-implementation flow that turns intent into reusable delivery artifacts and Copilot skills.

sessions.title: End-to-End Capstone Project
sessions.description: A bounded integration scenario covering governance, specification, agentic delivery, review, and handover.
